description: Normal header UA but payload.userAgent "curl/8.5.0". Upstream prefers the payload value for bot detection and fingerprinting.

expected_holocron.notes: payload.userAgent is honored only for requests authenticated with a site collection key (docs/decisions/0001, transient inputs). This unauthenticated request is classified by its User-Agent header, which is a browser, so the event is accepted. An authenticated server call with the same payload would be suppressed.
